1.consolidated_definition: "Lengüisucio" (término coloquial): persona que se caracteriza por tener dificultades para pronunciar ciertas palabras o sonidos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Linguisco (colloquialism): a person characterized by difficulties in pronouncing certain words or sounds.
